sections.title: Bank Metrics
sections.subtitle: The ratios the sanity check and DCF are actually built on -- margin, returns, capital and asset quality

charts.title: Asset Quality: NPL Ratio & Provision Coverage

balanceSheet.title: Balance sheet
balanceSheet.content:
Shareholders' equity is assets less liabilities; plotted against total liabilities to show leverage.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): equity that grows only through revaluations or share issues is not the same as retained earnings.

What to watch:

  • Liabilities growing faster than equity
  • Goodwill share of equity after acquisitions

deposits.title: Customer deposits
deposits.content:
Customer deposits are the bank's core funding base -- what depositors have placed with it, carried as a liability.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): there is no "cash vs debt" chart for a bank -- deposits and central-bank/interbank borrowings are the business, not leverage on top of it. Deposit growth funds loan growth at the rate the bank can reprice.

What to watch:

  • Deposit growth outrunning or lagging loan growth
  • Shift toward costlier time deposits versus cheap current accounts, which compresses NIM

nim.title: Net interest margin & spread
nim.content:
NIM is net interest income divided by average interest-earning assets; net interest spread is the yield on assets less the cost of funding. Both are the core profitability lever for a lender.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): NIM troughed at 1.51% in FY2025 and ticked up to 1.66% in H1 2026 as deposit repricing caught up with LPR cuts -- the base case holds it near 1.6%; the bear case assumes it resumes compressing toward 1.4%.

What to watch:

  • Whether the H1 2026 uptick persists or reverses
  • Deposit cost trends against further PBOC rate cuts

returns.title: ROE & ROA
returns.content:
ROE is net income over average shareholders' equity; ROA is net income over average total assets. For a bank, ROE is the headline profitability metric since capital, not revenue, is the scarce resource.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): ROE around 9-12% and ROA under 1% are typical for a Chinese regional bank; the DCF's FCFE is effectively ROE-driven earnings minus what must be retained to hold the CET1 target against RWA growth.

What to watch:

  • ROE trend versus the 10.5% cost of equity used in the DCF
  • ROA compression if credit costs or NIM worsen

capital.title: Capital adequacy
capital.content:
CET1, Tier 1 and total capital ratios are risk-weighted-asset-based regulatory capital buffers. For a bank, capital adequacy is what allows it to keep lending (and paying dividends) without a forced equity raise.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): CET1 fell from 14.24% to 12.33% in 18 months as RWA growth outran retained-earnings accretion -- this is the key risk the DCF flags, and the capex line in the model is actually equity retained to defend the CET1 target, not physical capex.

What to watch:

  • CET1 trend relative to the ~11.5% base-case floor
  • RWA growth outpacing retained earnings

assetQuality.title: Asset quality: NPL ratio & provision coverage
assetQuality.content:
NPL ratio is non-performing loans over total loans; provision coverage is loan-loss reserves over non-performing loans. Together they show how much bad debt there is and how well-reserved it is.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): NPL ratio improved to 1.05-1.08% with coverage over 350% through FY2025-H1 2026 -- the bear case assumes a Chongqing property/LGFV credit cycle pushes impairment back toward FY2021 levels.

What to watch:

  • NPL ratio ticking up, especially from property/LGFV exposure
  • Provision coverage falling toward 100% (under-reserved) versus staying comfortably above it

bvps.title: Book value per share
bvps.content:
Book value per share is shareholders' equity divided by shares outstanding -- the accounting net worth per H-share.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): the sanity check anchors this stock on P/B (it has no usable P/E or EV/EBITDA for a bank); BVPS compounded at a 6.9-7.0% 3/5-year CAGR, and the current HK$6.405 quote against RMB12.36 BVPS (H1 2026, converted at the model's CNY/HKD rate) is roughly 0.84x book versus a ~0.61x 10-year average.

What to watch:

  • BVPS growth rate versus the P/B the market is willing to pay
  • Dividend payout eating into BVPS growth

epsDps.title: EPS and dividends
epsDps.content:
EPS is net income per share; DPS is the cash dividend paid per share. Both are in major currency units.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): the payout ratio (DPS / EPS) shows how much of earnings is returned versus reinvested.

What to watch:

  • EPS growth versus net income growth (dilution)
  • Dividends funded from earnings, not debt

fcf.title: Net income vs FCFE
fcf.content:
A bank's reported operating cash flow is deposit-flow noise, not economic free cash flow, so there is no "owner FCF" card here. The DCF instead values FCFE (free cash flow to equity): net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders, less the equity that must be retained to hold the CET1 capital target against risk-weighted-asset growth.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): FY2026E FCFE is RMB4,969m against FY2025 net income of RMB12,128m -- the gap is capital retained to defend CET1, which fell from 14.24% to 12.33% over the prior 18 months.

What to watch:

  • Net income growth that doesn't translate to FCFE because RWA growth is absorbing it
  • Whether dividends paid exceed FCFE (drawing down the capital buffer)

margins.title: Margins
margins.content:
Gross margin is revenue less cost of revenue; operating margin deducts operating expenses; net margin is after interest and tax.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): the spread between gross and operating margin is the cost of running the business; a widening spread with flat gross margin means opex is growing faster than sales.

What to watch:

  • Direction of operating margin over several years, not one
  • One-offs (impairments, disposals) that distort net margin

profit.title: Profit lines
profit.content:
Gross profit is revenue less cost of revenue; operating income deducts operating expenses; net income is after interest, tax and one-offs.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): the three lines together show where margin is made and lost between the top line and the bottom.

What to watch:

  • Operating income growing slower than gross profit (opex creep)
  • Net income far from operating income (interest, tax, one-offs)

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.content:
Revenue is the top line: what customers paid for goods and services in the period, before any costs.

For Chongqing Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. (重慶農村商業銀行): the growth rate matters more than the level; compare it with the DCF's base-case growth path below.

What to watch:

  • Acceleration or deceleration in YoY growth
  • Whether growth is organic or acquired
  • Interim rows show seasonality
